answer_1.quote: we study the task of exercise generation in the context of adaptive learning... specifically, we ground our study in the domain of language learning to create exercise sentences for translation
datasets: Duolingo Second Language Acquisition Modeling (SLAM) dataset

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics include reference-based BLEU and METEOR, KC-Coverage which is the percentage of target knowledge components (words) that appear in the outputs, D-MAE which is the mean absolute error between the input difficulty and output difficulty, Invalid which is the percentage of exercises that have grammar errors detected using an automatic tool
